crossRefs.note: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.
Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,
They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips.
“Why do we sit still? Assemble yourselves! Let’s enter into the fortified cities, and let’s be silent there; for Yahweh…
“Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”
